Chapter 6702: One Outcome

Chapter 6702: One Outcome

“You discarded something like that?” Taichu asked.

Other listeners became speechless. Everyone pursued immortality and indestructibility. Alas, not even the primordial immortals had reached this state.

Taichu seemed unkillable right now but Li Qiye had reached this state before. Would Taichu abandon the will after experiencing its potential?

Most likely not since only a maniac would do so. However, Li Qiye returned the primordial will and its power to the world.

He was either a lunatic or had reached an unprecedented level. These were the only explanations.

“Just external.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I know you could have changed it into your true fate, it wouldn’t be external then.” Taichu said.

“Is that what you want to do?” Li Qiye asked.

“There is no reason not to, not even the high heaven can kill me then.” Taichu said.

“And nothing more.” Li Qiye smiled: “Nothing more.”

“Nothing more...” Taichu froze upon hearing this.

Overlords murmured the comment to themselves. Being unkillable by the high heaven was still not enough? No one had reached this height before; this was virtually true immortality.

“I apologize for my narrow ambition.” Taichu took a deep breath.

“Then you want more?” Li Qiye asked.

“Of course, although I am far from catching up to you, I will continue no matter what.” Taichu said.

“And I know you are prepared for death.” Li Qiye said casually, seemingly downplaying Taichu’s current cultivation.

“I’m still unsure whether you can kill me.” Taichu was aware of his current state.

“Of course, you’re not a true immortal and still are relying on external items.” Li Qiye said.

“What if I kill you first?” Taichu took a deep breath.

“Using the will?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Yes, from my limited knowledge, nothing else can do it.” Taichu said.

“It might be true, I haven’t tried it before.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“I suppose it’s a speed contest then, whether I can kill you first with the will or you breaking my invincibility.” Taichu said, having confidence in winning this race.

“I’ll be faster for sure.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m not someone who gives up without trying.” Taichu said.

“Then prepare for death.” Li Qiye nodded approvingly.

“Can we somehow try this in one decisive move, Sacred Teacher?” Taichu took a deep breath.

“Sure thing, just know there can only be one outcome.” Li Qiye said.

“Hahaha, the more confident you are, the more I refuse to believe it.” Taichu laughed despite knowing there wouldn’t be a fifth life.

“Virtuous Nephew, what’s the hurry? The main course hasn’t been served yet.” An ancient voice interrupted them.

Space twisted with ripples and became transparent like melting snow, revealing a world within the primordial tree.

Two figures came out, leaving the crowd speechless. They had no physical form and resembled fire avatars. They were also transparent but the tree’s world couldn’t be seen in the reflection.
